Name: Scorching Wave
Components: V, S, M (a red dragon’s scale)
Description: A line of roaring flame 30 feet long and 5 feet wide emanates from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d8 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 3rd level or higher, you can choose one of the following effects for each level above 2nd:
● The spell’s damage increases by a d8.
● The line’s width or length doubles.
● (2 levels) Any creature who fails their save is ignited, and while ignited this way they take fire damage from the condition equal to a d4 × the level you cast this spell at.
